purpose: Define 40 deterministic HNK40 Glyph Genesis structural seeds that remain distinct after angular-translation normalization. This is a structural search space, not canonical glyph art.

authorityBoundary.rule: A generated PATH may be mathematically valid without being visually, phonologically, semantically or canonically approved.

shapeLaw.angularBitRule: At each A position, bit 0 => ANGULAR_NEXT; bit 1 => ANGULAR_PREV.

wrapLaw: All sector arithmetic is modulo 72 with human sector range S01..S72.

shapeEquivalence.reason: Absolute sector translation alone must not be the only source of candidate distinctness.

invariants: Exactly 40 candidate IDs are generated: G01..G40.
Every candidate contains exactly nine MF nodes and eight legal MF edges.
All 40 angular-translation-normalized edge signatures are unique.
Every node round-trips through typed MF tuple, PixelMap, IsoPixel and Voxel.
Every candidate serializes through HNKP1-MF-TUPLE-BE and decodes to the identical ordered PATH.
No family rule assigns meaning, phoneme, sacred correspondence, color, sound or visual-canon status.
next: Materialize V1.1, validate 40 topology/transport vectors and normalized-shape uniqueness, then expose the candidates for human visual review.
